note: The single vocabulary list. web/tests/plain-language.test.mjs and
src/features/copy/__tests__/jargon.test.ts both read this file, so the
website and the app cannot drift apart silently — which they had.
Before this file existed the two lists shared exactly one term.
'deload', 'rung', 'accessories' and 'training block' were banned on the
site as unreadable by a first-time reader, and shipping in app copy the
everywhere - banned in all user-visible text on that surface.
prominent  - banned in titles, buttons, headings and onboarding;
allowed in body and summary text.
allowed    - not checked on that surface.
The tier may differ per surface, and where it does the reason is in
'why'. A website visitor is a stranger who leaves; an app user has
onboarded and reads the same words daily. Precision that earns its place
in an app summary does not earn it in a hero. Every divergence is here,
